# Architecture

SmartFill Lite is the standalone React/TypeScript Plasmo browser-extension app inside a Bun/Turbo monorepo. Its runtime does not depend on the sibling RAG app or a login backend.

## Core flow

```text
Popup / settings → Chrome messaging → content script → detect / scope / generate / fill page DOM
                          └────────→ background worker → selected AI provider
Popup / settings / content script ↔ chrome.storage.local (settings, form memory)
```

- [Popup](../../src/popup.tsx): current-page controls, fill mode, scope, status and undo actions.
- [Settings](../../src/options.tsx): provider, mock defaults, identity preferences, instructions, voice and saved-form management.
- [Content script](../../src/content.ts): page DOM operations and orchestration of detection, memory matching and filling.
- [Background worker](../../src/background.ts): AI completion, model listing and connection tests, plus extension messaging/shortcut handling.
- [Settings store](../../src/lib/settings.ts): defaults, local persistence, legacy sync migration, provider and voice resolution.
- [Form memory](../../src/lib/memory/store.ts): saved areas and values; [signatures](../../src/lib/memory/signature.ts) recognize them across visits.

## Module boundaries

| Directory | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `src/lib/detection/` | Discover and normalize supported form fields |
| `src/lib/mock/` | Local generation, profiles, regions and identity |
| `src/lib/filling/` | Apply values and capture/restore snapshots |
| `src/lib/memory/` | Persist and recognize saved forms and pinned values |
| `src/lib/picker/` | Shadow-rooted picker, highlights and result panels |
| `src/api/ai/`, `src/api/voice/` | Provider adapters, prompt/response and transcription logic |
| `src/components/`, `src/styles/` | Shared React primitives and theme/layout styles |
| `tests/` | Bun domain tests and local browser fixture |
| `scripts/` | Theme CSS generation |

## Invariants

- UI changes must not alter filling safety or auto-submit the visited form.
- Pinned values survive regeneration. Sensitive values are excluded from saved form values by the memory layer.
- Injected controls use a shadow root and top-layer host so page styles and dialogs do not break them.
- `tokens.ts` is the canonical theme source; the generator emits `tokens.css`, and overlay tokens are derived from the same source. See [the UI system](../UI-SYSTEM.md).
- This app stores settings locally; the comment in `src/config/env.ts` mentioning sync is stale. The executable settings store is authoritative.
